title: TrackMultiplayer
description: A Mod for track player In Minecraft Multiplayer
body:
**A Minecraft mod by which you can track any player in the Server**                              
Minecraft Version 1.21 - 1.21.11                                                                           
## Main Commands:-                                                                                       
**/tm help** - _To Check out the Purpose all Commands of the Mod_                                                                        
**/tm track** - _To track a Perticular player_                                                            
**/tm reload** - _To reload the mod_                                                                   
**/tm toggle** - _To Enable/Desable the mod_                                                           ![Player track UI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4831229ad91a4cae4fcf16c26237b25e8778b6d4.png)![Commands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/adf75d7cb1cfb5c420137c3a2c2d766a7a6c7d43.png)
